name: ckz_eff2500_init_strength_grid
_design: The two STRENGTH knobs in the init regime, swept TOGETHER (interaction untested). Fixed good loop (dark128, dense Cmin, anchors well). init_noise_level [0.6/0.75] = init strength (lower=loop anchors harder; higher=more novel). LoRA strength [0.85/1.0/1.15] = adapter strength; 1.0 was best for pure t2m but WITH an init providing structure the balance differs, and OVER-applying (1.15) may push the foreign latent harder onto the cKz timbre manifold (the missing-timbre fix). 2 seeds. Q: does some (noise x strength) combo give a novel loop-anchored melody with FULL cKz timbre? Rate timbre+melody+note.
